rv.q: Mary is his frustrated wife of several years. She is at a loss at how to communicate with George beyond the usual pleasantries and banal comments. Her life is bland and lacks color and excitement.
When a number of profound truths are revealed throughout the play, this makes the entire performance well worth seeing.

cn.t: Critics find this thoughtful production about a linguistics professor preserving dying languages intellectually engaging, praising its meaningful exploration of communication and human connection despite the protagonist's scholarly devotion outpacing his personal life.
